blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Sandiganbayan Third Division ordered the National Bureau Investigation (NBI) to bring Felicito Guevarra, a co-accused of former House Speaker Martin Romualdez in the P7.4-billion plunder case, before the court on December 4, Friday, for his arraignment. According to Clerk of Court Dennis Pulma, a produce order was signed on Thursday, November 26. “May produce order for the NBI to bring Guevarra on Friday to coincide sa last day ng bail hearing,” Pulma told reporters. (There is a produce order for the NBI to bring Guevarra on Friday to coincide on the last day of the bail hearing.) […]...
